title: A Second-Order Descent Algorithm for Nonlinear Equality Constrained Optimization
summary: In this paper, an adaptive second-order descent algorithm (ASODA) is proposed for solving nonlinear equality constrained optimization problems. By integrating a sequential quadratic programming approach with the homogeneous second-order descent framework (HSODF: He et al., Math. Program. 215, 575--636, 2026), each iteration of ASODA decomposes the trial step into a normal step and a tangential step. The latter is computed by converting the linearly constrained subproblem into an unconstrained one via the reduced-Hessian technique and then solving it using a generalized homogeneous model. The…
